exposure: Before and after introduction of the educational package and umbilical artery lactate sampling
Educational package of fetal heart rate monitoring education
cohort: 936 consecutive samples (374 pre-intervention and 562 post-intervention) in a low-resource setting labor ward in Pretoria, South Africa
finding: The introduction of an educational package of fetal heart rate monitoring education combined with routine umbilical artery cord lactate sampling significantly reduced caesarean section rates without increasing adverse neonatal outcomes.
